action_token_materialization.action1_action2: first40 IDs each with fixed separator [198]; no observations/action3+/future plan content
action_token_materialization.action3: exact full stored action3 IDs; require len<=96 before E freeze; no truncation/rescue
action_token_materialization.rule: After the fixed five reference actions are available and before E freeze, encode exact command strings for actions1,2,3 exactly once each with add_special_tokens=False; persist literal ID arrays and canonical hashes. PAST_ACTIONS_ONLY and NEXT_ACTION_PRESERVED_LATE_NULL consume only these stored arrays.

held_fixed: exactly one reset-prefix injection, same persistent KV/session, no reinjection
MSA2/LCA2 endpoints, thresholds, statistics, competence/plumbing guards

neutral_filler.derivation: Encode primitive_text exactly once with add_special_tokens=False under the frozen tokenizer. Then repeat the resulting integer ID cycle and prefix-slice to 128 IDs. Persist and use the literal 128-ID stream directly; scientific execution must not decode or re-tokenize it.

past_actions_separator.rule: PAST_ACTIONS_ONLY = first40 stored action1 IDs + [198] + first40 stored action2 IDs; max81.

plan_token_materialization.boundary_overlap_rule: Any token whose offset overlaps either literal tag span or crosses open_end/close_start is FROZEN in place. Boundary-overlap is not itself ineligible; this specifically handles tokenizer merges such as the token spanning ">\n" after <PLAN>.
plan_token_materialization.derangement_rule: Apply the frozen strict balanced-block left rotation to the ordered mutable-ID sequence; accept only if output sequence differs and its rightmost mutable value changes. Otherwise choose the smallest ordinary left rotation satisfying both. Write transformed values back only to mutable positions; every other token ID remains exact.
plan_token_materialization.literal_tag_char_spans: Locate exactly one full <PLAN>...</PLAN> block by the already frozen case-insensitive fullmatch parser. Let open_end be the character end of the literal opening tag and close_start the character start of the literal closing tag.
plan_token_materialization.mutable_interior_rule: Mutable positions are exactly token indices with nonempty offset, start>=open_end and end<=close_start. Require >=2 mutable positions and >=2 distinct mutable token IDs before E freeze. Otherwise Stage1-ineligible, no replacement.
plan_token_materialization.single_tokenization_rule: After planner acceptance and before Stage1 E freeze, tokenize the exact accepted plan_text exactly once with add_special_tokens=False and return_offsets_mapping=True; persist input_ids, offsets and canonical hashes. Downstream semantic-control construction must use those stored IDs only.

slot_geometry.direct_splice: full replay IDs = encode(replay_prefix) + slot_ids + encode(replay_suffix); no slot decode/re-tokenize
